decisions.reason: Although it is a multi-model line, this submarine-focused offer is relatively far from the firm's core range and less visibly committed on the website, so by 2022 management is more likely to stop it and redirect resources despite some sunk-cost pull.

This explosion-proof luminaire line builds directly on the firm's industrial lighting business, was given its own page, and even received a new LED replacement kit, which makes management strongly inclined to continue it.

The relaunched designer task light had explicit public positioning and draws on the existing lighting business, so escalation of commitment makes management likely to retain it unless results are clearly poor.

The office pendant luminaire fits the firm's established professional-building market, but as a newer single product with less visible follow-on commitment it faces a moderate, not dominant, risk of being withdrawn.
The premium pendant luminaire is close to the core offer and was launched as a multi-model line, so the firm's sunk investment and strategic fit make continued marketing more likely than withdrawal.
